top_choice_rationale: Buchwald and Hartwig give the cleanest combination of novelty, maturity and attribution. C-N coupling needed ligand-controlled solutions to different mechanistic problems than the 2010 C-C couplings (amine binding, beta-hydride elimination from amido complexes, difficult C-N reductive elimination), each explained mechanistically. It has been a default disconnection in medicinal and process chemistry for about thirty years, and the two-name allocation is unambiguous, with the Kosugi tin-amide precursor distinguished by generality.
